# hetznerrobot_server_cancellation (Data Source)

Reads the cancellation data of a server: the earliest possible date, the accepted reasons and whether a cancellation is active.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hetznerrobot_server_cancellation" "web" {
  server_number = 321
}

output "earliest_cancellation" {
  value = data.hetznerrobot_server_cancellation.web.earliest_cancellation_date
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_number` (Number) Server number.

### Read-Only

- `cancellation_date` (String) Date of the active cancellation; null when none is active.
- `cancellation_reason` (String) Reason of the active cancellation; null when none is active.
- `cancellation_reasons` (List of String) Possible cancellation reasons while none is active; the chosen one once it is.
- `cancelled` (Boolean) Whether a cancellation is active.
- `earliest_cancellation_date` (String) Earliest possible cancellation date.
- `reservation_possible` (Boolean) Whether the location can be reserved after a cancellation.
- `reserved` (Boolean) Whether the location will be reserved.
- `server_ip` (String) Main IP address of the server.
- `server_name` (String) Name of the server.
